text:
The volume of the hole is  

\[
6\text{ ft} \times 4\text{ ft} \times 3\text{ ft}=72\text{ ft}^3 .
\]

Bob shovels 1 ft³ in 3 seconds, so the total time required is  

\[
72\text{ ft}^3 \times 3\text{ s/ft}^3 = 216\text{ seconds}.
\]

\(216\) seconds equals \(3\) minutes \(36\) seconds.

**Final answer:** 216 seconds.
